name: Null Runner
detailed_description:
Null Runner is a cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder where every run is a high-stakes score. Infiltrate secure networks, manipulate enemy firewalls, and deploy devastating exploits before the system locks you out — and tracks you down.

Build your deck. Crack the servers. Escape before the NullTrace finds you.

[BREACH PROTOCOL]

Each round is a cyber breach in progress — cards hit servers, defenses react, and the system closes in. Mistakes will end your Run— permanently.

  • Play cards directly onto servers to crack their defenses.

  • Manipulate, delete, or reroute enemy cards trying to lock you out.

  • Read the enemy defenses and track what countermeasures they're likely to play next.

  • Stack passive Hardware for cascading effects and long-term combos.

  • Score big by cracking two servers before the trace catches up — the faster you finish, the more BYTES you earn.

Play smart. Play fast. One misstep and hunter-seeker programs will flatline you.

[Break the System (Before It Breaks You)]

Every Run delivers new tools, synergies, and strategic hacks. Build your rig, adapt on the fly, and push your luck as you go breach deeper into corporate defenses.

  • Null Runner Factions – Each playable character has a unique hacker playstyle.

  • Hardware Modules – Each passive transforms how your entire deck functions.

  • Max Security Bosses – Each score against a faction pits you against a game breaking boss.

  • Digital Black Market – Spend earned BYTES in shops after each match to customize your deck mid-run, optimizing your strategy and building for the next boss.

The deeper you go, the wilder the combos — but the clock is always ticking. One day your luck will run out, best to score as many BYTES as possible and retire in style. 

[Null Runner TOOLKIT]

Null Runner pulls you into a future of corporate espionage and digital warfare, where every card could flip the outcome of your NullRun.

  • Streamlined, high-stakes roguelike runs with deep tactical weight

  • Post-run analytics to break down your performance and refine your builds

  • Unlock new characters, cards, and passive hardware the longer you play and the more you win!

  • Jack-in with an atmospheric synth soundtrack to drive your flow state

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+
  • Processor: Dual-core CPU, 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD 5000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Should run on most modern laptops and desktops
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual-core CPU, 2.5+ GHz
  • Memory: 4,096 MB MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (GeForce GTX 660 / Radeon HD 7850 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: For best experience: 1080p screen, 60+ FPS

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur)
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 2,048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Supports both Intel and Apple Silicon
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 (Monterey)
  • Processor: Apple M1 or newer
  • Memory: 4,096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Native Apple Silicon supported
